Once you are standing next to the black chairs look straight ahead more towards the black chairs their is an opening to go outside. do not go outside just go near and stand. Once you are standing near the open door just at the back door you should see a room or another door at the back of it  and walk towards that and now you should be standing near a desk and  at the back of the brown chairs, when you are standing at the chair turn right and now you should be standing near the foot of the bed, once you are here you are done.

subtasks: You are facing a bedroom. Turn around to face the two chairs on the wall; the kitchen with blue cabinets and a steel oven is straight ahead, with the rocks outside as an additional visual reference. Turn right and move towards the same area with the chairs. When you are standing next to the black chairs, look straight ahead towards the opening to go outside. Do not go outside; move near the opening and stand there. From near the open back door, look towards a room or another door visible at the back of it and move towards that target. Continue until you are near a desk and at the back of the brown chairs. When you are standing at the chair, turn right and continue until you are standing near the foot of the bed. This is your destination.
